title: Yield Not to Temptation
description: Yield Not to Temptation in Tonic Solfa to FORTITUDE (PALMER): the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Horatio R. Palmer wrote the words and the tune in 1868; they were first published in the National Sunday School Teachers’ Magazine.
underlay: Yield not to temp-ta-tion, for yield-ing is sin; Each vict’-ry will help you some oth-er to win; Fight man-ful-ly on-ward, dark pas-sions sub-due; Look ev-er to Je-sus, He will car-ry you through. Ask the Sa-viour to help you, Com-fort, strength-en, and keep you; He is will-ing to aid you, He will car-ry you through.

lines: Yield not to temptation, for yielding is sin;
Each vict’ry will help you some other to win;
Fight manfully onward, dark passions subdue;
Look ever to Jesus, He will carry you through.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: Ask the Saviour to help you,
He is willing to aid you,
Shun evil companions, bad language disdain,
God’s name hold in rev’rence, nor take it in vain;
Be thoughtful and earnest, kindhearted and true;
Look ever to Jesus, He will carry you through.
To him that o’ercometh, God giveth a crown,
Through faith we will conquer, though often cast down;
He who is our Saviour, our strength will renew;
Look ever to Jesus, He will carry you through.
